repository.name: i-have-adhd
repository.description: A skill to stop your coding agent from burying the answer. ADHD-friendly output.

releases.name: v0.4.1
releases.body:
## Changes

- Replaced the illustrative npm installation command with a direct file-edit example in the skill and README.
- Synchronized the example across all translated READMEs.
- Added a French README and French language-navigation links.
- Bumped plugin versions so existing Claude Code installations can receive the updated skill.
